title: Face-selective ventral occipito-temporal responses to fast periodic visual stimulation, SEEG (Jonas et al., 2016) (derivative)
description: Stereo-EEG (intracerebral) recordings from 28 patients with refractory epilepsy during fast periodic visual stimulation. Natural object images were presented at 6 Hz, with faces appearing as every fifth image (1.2 Hz) in the periodic condition and at random positions in a non-periodic control condition. This derivative release contains the original authors' Letswave files, low-pass filtered at 30 Hz and segmented into sequences, repackaged in BIDS/BrainVision format to map face-selective responses in the ventral occipito-temporal cortex.
methods_description: SEEG was recorded with a 256-channel amplifier at 512 Hz (Micromed TRC), with depth electrodes of 8-15 contacts and scalp electrodes recorded simultaneously. The reference was either a midline prefrontal scalp electrode (FPz) or an intracerebral white-matter contact. Data were imported into Letswave 5, low-pass filtered at 30 Hz (Butterworth, order 4), cropped from 2 s after onset to about 65 s, and merged per condition.
